title: StreamX Torrent Indexer — Source Definition
description: Schema for a single site under sources/verified/ or sources/community/. Mirrors crate/src/schema.rs::SiteConfig exactly — see tools/validator --emit-json-schema to regenerate this file if the two ever drift.

id.description: Unique slug. Must match the filename (sources/*/<id>.json, no extension) and, if ported from Jackett, should match Jackett's own indexer id where practical.

excluded_mirrors.description: Mirrors permanently blocklisted from tools/jackett-sync's auto-update, even if Jackett's own upstream links: still lists them. Only for domains confirmed genuinely dead (DNS failure) — NOT for a mirror that's merely bot-challenge-blocked, which is still live for real users.

search_path.description: Path appended to a mirror, with {query} substituted, e.g. "/search/{query}/1/".

search_method.description: HTTP method for the search request. Defaults to GET. Set to "post" for sites whose search endpoint expects a form-encoded POST body (see search_body) instead of query-string params.

search_body.description: POST body template, used only when search_method is "post". Same {query}/{page} substitution as search_path. Always sent as application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

jackett_id.description: Required (non-null) when kind is 'jackett'. This is the join key jackett-sync uses to auto-detect upstream domain changes.

last_verified.description: Set automatically by tools/jackett-sync — do not set by hand in a contribution PR.

upstream_removed.description: Set automatically by tools/jackett-sync when Jackett has deleted the upstream YAML this was ported from. Do not set by hand.

download_type.description: "magnet" (default) = magnet_* / detail_magnet_selector fields below extract a real magnet: URI, exactly as before. "torrent_file" = this site has no magnet on the page at all — the SAME selector fields point at an authenticated .torrent download link instead (the norm for private trackers); the engine writes the extracted URL into TorrentResult::torrent_file_url instead of ::magnet.

authConfig.description: Metadata describing what kind of session this private tracker needs. Never contains a secret — the actual per-user cookie lives only on-device (see crate/src/schema.rs's AuthConfig doc comment).

method.description: The only auth method the engine implements — the app captures a real login's session cookie (via an in-app WebView) and supplies it at search time. Never a stored username/password.

instructions.description: Human-readable hint shown in the app's private-tracker login screen for this specific site.

login_check_path.description: Path to fetch (relative to a mirror) to verify a stored cookie is still valid, before running an actual search with it.

login_check_selector.description: CSS selector present only on login_check_path when genuinely logged in (e.g. a logout link) — used to confirm the cookie still works.
